contracts.commit_point: await api.create_ticket(...) inside the create_ticket tool body (tickets.py lines 65–71) — the agent tool-call execution that commits the external ticket-creation request to the HR API.
contracts.declared_mechanism: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware(interrupt_on={"create_ticket": {"allowed_decisions": ["approve", "reject"]}}, description_prefix="Подтвердите создание заявки") is registered in build_scenario_executor's middleware list (executor.py lines 168–171) and wired into the agent via create_agent(tools=list(tools), middleware=middleware, ...) (executor.py lines 173–181), interrupting the create_ticket tool call before execution. EpisodeManager.resume, for episodes with status "waiting_approval", resumes the executor with Command(resume={"decisions": [{"type": "approve"}] or [{"type": "reject", ...}]}) (episodes.py lines 186–189). The tool passes idempotency_key=f"{thread_id}:{runtime.tool_call_id}" (tickets.py line 70) and the HRApi Protocol declares idempotency_key mandatory because the interrupt node re-runs on resume (api.py lines 67–68). Executor runs use durability="sync" so the checkpoint containing the employee decision is persisted before the create_ticket side effect (episodes.py lines 239–243).
contracts.forbidden_condition: api.create_ticket executing — and a support ticket being created — without a prior explicit employee decision carried through the HITL interrupt/resume path; equivalently, the effect committing on any path other than interrupt → Command(resume={"decisions": [{"type": "approve"}|{"type": "reject"}]}) → tool re-execution. Secondary forbidden condition: on the post-resume re-execution of the tools node, creating a second ticket for the same tool call (idempotency_key not supplied or not honored).

Merges the two duplicate reviewer wordings (Russian first-phase and English second-phase) of the same obligation.
